_meta.comment: Golden headline numbers for CP-12 end-to-end regression. Regenerated against current monitors after the consistency PL fix (HPL tracks disagreement). Relative tolerance in the test is 1e-3. Synthetic-fault entries are not field-observed mine data.

sigma_star_m.comment: σ* from outputs/sigma_sweep: claimed horizontal σ where naive MDR first drops to ≤0.1% on clean anymal_1 (CP-7 / sigma_sweep).

ate_rmse_m.comment: Umeyama-aligned ATE RMSE on clean CompSLAM vs CERBERUS GT (CP-6).

missed_detection_rate.comment: Naive@σ* MDR on clean data — near-zero; well-tuned static cov looks safe (sigma_sweep / multiseq).

false_alarm_rate.comment: Naive never leaves NOMINAL ⇒ FAR ≡ 0 by construction.

mean_pl_m.comment: χ² HPL at σ* ≈ 0.26 m (~0.74× ATE).

missed_detection_rate.comment: MDR≈0 on clean data — demoted; P95 PL inflation is the tell (CP-8 demotion).

mean_pl_m.comment: Mean PL ~2× naive — inflation / cowardice on clean run.

p95_pl_m.comment: P95 PL ≈ 5× ATE — primary demotion evidence.

missed_detection_rate.comment: No missed detections on clean CompSLAM at σ*.

false_alarm_rate.comment: Baseline SS FAR from synthetic primary/prop/lag sources (~14%).

drift_injected.comment: SYNTHETIC along-track drift (0.02 m/s from 30% mark) via scripts/inject_faults.py — not observed mine drift.

ate_rmse_m.comment: ATE after synthetic drift — headline hard case.

missed_detection_rate.comment: Headline: naive@σ* misses ~94% of epochs under synthetic drift (multiseq / product claim).

availability.comment: Always NOMINAL while error grows to ~20 m.

missed_detection_rate.comment: Still ~88% MDR — demoted; does not catch drift.

false_alarm_rate.comment: Some alarms but not drift-responsive (duty never reaches 50%).

missed_detection_rate.comment: Headline: consistency MDR ~12% under synthetic drift vs naive 94% (order-of-magnitude claim).

false_alarm_rate.comment: FAR after PL-grows-with-disagreement fix (CP-9 PL bugfix).

availability.comment: ~25% availability — abstention objection; answered by drift-timing duty metric.

mean_pl_m.comment: Mean HPL after PL fix — grows with disagreement (was frozen at 0.485 m).

p95_pl_m.comment: P95 HPL under drift — PL tracks source disagreement.

common_mode.comment: SYNTHETIC common-mode drift: same epoch offset applied to primary/prop/lag (CP-9 independence limitation). scripts/common_mode_fault.py.

missed_detection_rate.comment: Consistency misses common-mode faults — MDR ~73% (limitations slide).

false_alarm_rate.comment: Low FAR; monitor stays mostly NOMINAL while wrong.

alarm_fraction_after_onset.comment: ~9% alarmed post-onset vs ~97% for single-source control — discriminating signal.

drift_timing.comment: Product metric: rolling 5 s alarm duty ≥ 50%, full post-onset window (CP-11). SYNTHETIC drift.

consistency_time_to_detection_s.comment: Δt after drift onset until duty≥50% — ARA headline (~12 s).

consistency_true_error_at_detection_m.comment: True horizontal error at detection (~0.54 m) vs naive never-alarm max ~20.5 m.

consistency_detected.comment: Must detect under the headline duty rule.
